tasks.short: Find prospective clients by networking and list them.

steps.what: Network in person to find prospective clients.
Add those prospective clients to the list.
Send a first note only where consent exists.

loop.input: Prospect note and the consent flag
loop.check: Agent checks the name and that consent is true
loop.stop: No consent, no draft; one draft only
loop.why_not_simpler: A note from a conversation is not a template

tasks.design: Networking stays in the room. The {CRM} list takes the names the agent writes, and {EMAIL} sends a note only when the consent flag is true and the agent has read it. Test the {CRM} consent field before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Names from events sat in notebooks, and a later mail could not show whether the person had agreed to be contacted.
tasks.enabler_now: A consent flag on the prospect record is enough to hold or release a note.
tasks.still_hard: The useful introduction happens in the room, not in the note.
tasks.human_edge: The agent hears who is worth a second conversation.
tasks.altitude: The events stay. The agent no longer copies names twice, and a note without consent does not go out.

reach.task: Keep a record of who agreed to a follow-up visit
reach.learn: How they separate a conversation from permission to write again

evidence.claim: A sales system can research leads and draft outreach mail.
Since 1 July 2026, calls to consumers, zzp and vof need prior opt-in, existing customers included.
From 2 August 2026 an AI caller or chat must say it is AI unless that is obvious.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. Boundary: from a networking conversation to a listed prospect or a consented note. A sale is out of scope.
Structured fields are name, how they met, consent yes or no, and channel. The agent produces them at the event. Fallback: no consent flag means no note.
Test {CRM} lead fields and email templates before custom code.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the note template. Calls to consumers, zzp and vof still need opt-in.
If a model drafted the note, the note says so. The agent sends it. No dialler is added here.
unknowns: Whether this agency already stores a consent flag per prospect.
What share of new names come from events rather than inbound mail.
research_questions: What share of event conversations already include a clear yes to a follow-up?
Which channels does this agency still use for a first contact?

already_counted.description: Check of the outreach note and consent flag

incremental.description: Keep the outreach template and consent values current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: almost all the hour is the event, and few people give consent. High case: listing and the note shrink, and the event stays in full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Visit policyholders to explain the policy or change it.

steps.what: Prepare the policy pack for the policyholder visit.

loop.output: Visit pack: covers, beneficiaries, open changes
loop.check: Agent checks beneficiaries and covers against the record
loop.stop: One pass; a missing beneficiary stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Beneficiary lines are often free text on the schedule

steps.what: Deliver and explain the policy at the visit.
Analyse the insurance program against the household now.
Suggest additions or a beneficiary change.
Send the beneficiary change the policyholder accepted.

tasks.design: The {CRM} builds a visit pack from the policy record. The visit, the gap judgement and the suggestion stay with the agent. A beneficiary change is sent only after the agent checks the wording the policyholder accepted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Schedules were printed and re-read in the car, and beneficiary changes were retyped into mail.
tasks.enabler_now: Beneficiary, cover and date are fields, so the pack and the change request can be filled from the visit note.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing whether this household still matches the program.
tasks.human_edge: The agent notices a beneficiary who should not stay on the policy.

ambition.what: The agent decides during the visit whether a beneficiary change is complete enough to send.

tasks.altitude: Visits stay. The agent spends less time rebuilding the pack and the change form.

reach.task: Walk a client through a change to an agreed instruction
reach.learn: How they record a spoken change before it is sent

evidence.claim: A Dutch insurance system uses one certified product-definition format for policy records and renewals.
Advising staff need a Wft diploma per product and professional education every three years.
Choosing cover for a person, and saying it in the meeting, stays with the adviser.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. Boundary: from the policy record to a visit and any change the policyholder accepted. Claims payment is out of scope.
Structured fields are policy number, beneficiary name, cover code and change type. The policy record and the agent produce them. Fallback: a blank beneficiary blocks the send.
Test the {CRM} schedule template before custom code.
Upkeep of 1.5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the pack template.
Suggesting a new cover is advice under the Wft rule and stays with the agent.
unknowns: Whether beneficiary is a structured field or a line on a scanned schedule.
How often a visit is only a delivery, with no change.
research_questions: What share of visits end in a beneficiary change?
Does the insurer accept a structured change, or only a signed form?

incremental.description: Update the visit pack template when schedules change

approvals.approved_version: beneficiary change accepted at the visit

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the household has changed and the visit is almost all judgement. High case: delivery visits reuse the pack and only a clean beneficiary change is sent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with clients when a claim is made.

steps.what: Read the claim notice and the policy wording.

loop.input: Claim notice and the policy schedule
loop.output: Claim brief: date, what happened, cover named
loop.check: Agent checks the brief against the notice
loop.stop: One pass; a missing date stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Notices arrive as mail, not as a fixed form

steps.what: Confer with the client about the claim facts.
Pass the claim facts to the claims handler.
Tell the client what was passed on.

loop.output: Client update that does not add a decision
loop.check: Agent removes any line that decides the claim
loop.stop: One draft; if the note is incomplete the update is not sent
loop.why_not_simpler: The client expects a sentence, not a field dump

tasks.design: A claim brief is extracted from the notice and checked. The conferral stays a call. The handler note and the client update go out only after the agent reads them, and the update does not decide the claim.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agent re-read the schedule during the call and then retyped the story twice, once to the handler and once to the client.
tasks.enabler_now: The notice and the schedule can fill a brief. The call still collects what the notice left out.
tasks.still_hard: The client is upset, and the claim decision is not the agent's.
tasks.human_edge: The agent hears the fact the notice missed.
tasks.altitude: Calls stay. The agent spends less of the hour retyping the same facts.

reach.task: Take a traveller's account of a disrupted trip and pass it to the operator
reach.learn: What they write down before they promise an outcome

evidence.claim: A Dutch insurance system uses one certified product-definition format for policy records and renewals.
The agent can gather claim facts but does not settle the claim.
Call recording of sellers needs works council consent.

assumptions: Focal role is the insurance sales agent. Boundary: from a claim notice to facts passed to the handler and a status told to the client. Settlement is out of scope.
Structured fields are claim date, what happened, policy number and cover named. The notice produces the first pass; the client corrects it. Fallback: the agent types blanks during the call.
Test {CRM} claim activity and mail templates before custom code. Do not turn on call recording without works council consent.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the brief and the update template.
The client update must not say a claim is accepted or refused.
unknowns: Whether this agency's agents are expected to touch claims at all.
research_questions: What share of claim notices already name the cover?
How often is the client update a call rather than mail?

incremental.description: Maintain claim brief and update templates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the call is long and the notice is messy, so the brief saves little. High case: the notice is complete and only the call stays at full length.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview prospective clients about needs and existing coverage.

steps.what: Interview prospective clients about needs and existing coverage.
Record financial resources and the property condition.

loop.output: Fact file: resources, property condition, existing coverage
loop.check: Agent checks figures against the notes
loop.stop: One pass; a figure not in the notes is dropped
loop.why_not_simpler: The interview is speech, not a form

steps.what: Ask again where the interview left a required fact blank.

tasks.design: The interview stays in the room. Notes fill a {CRM} fact file, and the agent checks every figure. A follow-up question goes out only for a blank required field, after the agent reads it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Facts lived in notebooks and were typed into the file later, often with a gap nobody had noticed.
tasks.enabler_now: Required fields for resources, property condition and existing coverage make a blank visible the same day.
tasks.still_hard: People understate a risk or a resource, and only the conversation shows it.
tasks.human_edge: The agent notices when an answer does not match the property in front of them.

ambition.what: The agent decides before leaving the interview which required fact is still blank.

tasks.altitude: Interviews stay the week. The agent stops discovering a missing fact the next morning.

Structured fields are income band, property type, condition note and existing coverage code. The client says them; the agent records them. Fallback: the agent types anything the extract drops.
Test {CRM} fact fields before custom code.
Upkeep of 1 hour per 100 baseline hours covers required-field changes.
The interview is advice-related fact finding under the Wft rule and is not delegated.

Which resource fields this agency treats as required.
research_questions: What share of interviews already use a form?
How often is a second contact needed only because a field was blank?

incremental.description: Adjust required fact fields when products change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the interview is the whole hour and notes are too messy to extract. High case: only the write-up and the blank chase shrink.

role.altitude: Networking, visits, claim calls and interviews stay. Listing, packs and write-ups take less of the week. The agent can block a note that has no consent or a change the policyholder did not accept.
skills_to_grow: Checking a beneficiary line against what was said
Keeping a claim update free of a decision
role.ambitious_version: The agent spends the contacts on the person, and the file shows consent, facts and accepted changes without a second typing.
